summary.text: One of the forty-four suitors from Zacynthus in Apollodorus' island catalogue — a namesake of, but not to be identified with, Antenor the Trojan elder who counselled peace and was spared when the city fell.

story.text: Apollodorus names Antenor among the wooers assigned to Zacynthus, listed after Periclymenus and before Pellas in Epitome 7.29.
